requirements: Retail invoice and EAD.

decisions.name: Vanuatu
decisions.reason: Vanuatu Plant Import Specifications Appendix 1.1 permits commercially packaged and labelled processed food, including cooked/dried plant products, from any country without import permit or phytosanitary certificate. Inspection remains required. Sealed steam-processed dried sencha fits this published category; generic agricultural restrictions do not negate it.
requirements: Retail invoice and EAD identifying sealed processed dried green tea.
Declare for biosecurity inspection; retain original commercial packaging and label.

decisions.name: Wallis and Futuna

requirements: Retail invoice and EAD; pay assessed import charges.
Obtain SIVAP authorisation and comply with certificate instructions before dispatch.
